dataset.eligible_filter: neutral records; elements exactly within [H,C,N,O,F,P,S,Cl,Br,I]; finite MBIS q/p and SCF dipole
dataset.split: sha256(top-level molecule name) modulo 10: train 0-6, validation 7, test 8-9; conformers never cross splits

decision.continue_if: test MBIS q and p errors improve over unchanged MACE-MDP latent q/p, exact Q/mu closure holds, and no numerical instability appears
decision.next_gate_if_positive: larger SPICE training, rotation/coordinate-VJP implementation, exterior/surface MEP and fixed-source ddPCM gates before any 505 run
decision.stop_if: no molecule-held-out source-label improvement; this prototype cannot be tuned using PCM or solvation results

frozen_backbone.features: two product layers; concatenate 128 scalar and 128 vector channels per layer

head.charge: ridge regression from invariant scalar channels plus element one-hot to MBIS atomic charge
head.dipole: one shared SO(3)-equivariant ridge contraction of vector channels to MBIS atomic dipole
head.selection: charge and dipole ridge selected separately by molecule-held-out validation RMSE

objective: Test whether independent QM source supervision can repair the frozen MACE-MDP atomwise partition without any solvation target.

projection.constraints: exact total charge and exact frozen MACE-MDP molecular dipole
projection.rank: local dipole variables make the four-row Schur system full rank for every nonempty geometry
projection.scales: training residual RMSE only, floored at 1e-6 in declared units
